name: Claw Compactor
description: Compresses LLM context such as code, JSON, logs, and chat history through a reversible 14-stage pipeline with no LLM calls, via a Python API and CLI, for agent developers.

skills.name: Fusion Pipeline Compression
skills.description: Routes code, JSON, logs, diffs, and search results through content-aware stages to cut token counts without LLM inference.

skills.name: Reversible Rewind Retrieval
skills.description: Stores originals behind hash markers so the LLM can call a tool to retrieve any compressed section.

skills.name: Chat Message Compression
skills.description: Compresses chat message lists with cross-message deduplication before the per-message pipeline.

skills.name: Workspace Commands
skills.description: Benchmarks, compresses, deduplicates, and estimates tokens across a workspace, with a watch mode for file changes.
